product.name: CNC Milling
product.description: A machining process used to create precise and complex parts by removing material from wood using computer-controlled systems.

product.name: Laser Cutting
product.description: A technique that uses a focused laser beam to cut and engrave wood materials with high precision.

product.name: Sawing
product.description: A process that utilizes advanced saw cutters to deliver precise cuts on wood materials, including straight, angled, and complex shapes.

product.name: Edgebanding
product.description: A process of applying a narrow strip of material to the edges of wood panels to create a finished look and protect the edges.

product.name: Sanding & Finishing
product.description: Processes that involve smoothing the surface of wood parts and applying finishes to enhance appearance and durability.

product.name: Flatpacks
product.description: Pre-cut and ready-to-assemble furniture components that can be efficiently transported and assembled on-site.
